newsitem.title: USA: Digi Intl continues inventory adjustment.
newsitem.headline: Digi Intl continues inventory adjustment.

text.p: Digi International Inc said Wednesday that sales in the third quarter ended June 30 were down from a year ago because it continues to adjust downward inventory in the pipeline.

"One of the actions we continued in the third fiscal quarter 1997 was the company's conscious effort to reach greater parity in our distribution channels between product being sold into the channel and those being sold out of it, " said Jerry Dusa, president and chief executive of Digi International, in a news release.
"We came in on target with our revenues as we continued to accomplish this task."
The company reported sales of $40.8 million in the quarter, down from $49.6 million a year ago as it continues to target the amount of sales entering the inventory pipeline.
"We're picking the number" of sales posted, chief financial officer John Killmer said. "That number will probably be the same in the next two quarters."
